label: Resources, Skills and Public Work
quiz: How could resources and education support public participation?
By helping people obtain materials and develop skills for public work.
By giving every family identical income.
By making travel the only source of knowledge.
By measuring a person's worth through school fees.
retry: Which example connects resources with a public activity?
Time, support and printing materials help a group prepare a publication.
An expensive cover proves every claim in a book.
A professional title proves all readers agree.
Lack of travel funds proves lack of useful knowledge.
hard: A fictional group has funds for printing but needs a translator for its intended readers. What should its plan consider?
Both material resources and the language skills needed for the audience.
Only the price of the paper, because language does not matter.
Only travel abroad, because local skills cannot contribute.
Only the fame of its wealthiest member.

label: Translation and Readers
quiz: What did del Pilar contribute to the 1882 Amor Patrio case?
A Tagalog translation of Rizal's essay.
The opening of El Ilocano in 1889.
The Malolos school request in 1888.
The construction of the Suez Canal.
retry: Why can a Tagalog translation matter to a reader who cannot read Spanish?
It makes the message available in a language the reader understands.
It proves the reader must agree with every statement.
It changes the author into the founder of every newspaper.
It guarantees that every household receives a copy.
hard: Which label correctly distinguishes the two roles?
Rizal wrote Amor Patrio; del Pilar translated it into Tagalog.
Del Pilar wrote Amor Patrio; Rizal translated it for the Malolos request.
The Malolos women wrote El Ilocano; Rizal opened its printing press.
De los Reyes opened the Suez Canal; del Pilar recorded its route.

label: Regional Publishing
quiz: Which publication belongs with Isabelo de los Reyes in 1889?
El Ilocano.
Diariong Tagalog in its 1882 translation case.
The Malolos women's 1888 school request.
The Iloilo Port opening record of 1855.
retry: What action did de los Reyes take in the regional publishing case?
Founded a newspaper called El Ilocano.
Translated Amor Patrio for Diariong Tagalog in 1882.
Requested permission for the Malolos school in 1888.
Opened a canal between the Mediterranean and Red Seas.
hard: What can founding El Ilocano most directly support in the exhibit?
A named example of creating a regional publication.
A count of every person who read the newspaper.
Proof that every reader held the same opinion.
Proof that regional work required a school in Madrid.

label: Women Organizing for Education
quiz: What did the Malolos women request in 1888?
Permission to open a Spanish-language school at their own expense.
Permission to translate the Suez Canal records into Tagalog.
Ownership of El Ilocano in Vigan.
The return of Iloilo's sugar shipment from Melbourne.
retry: Who initiated the educational request in the Malolos example?
The women who organized and made the request.
A later letter that replaced the women's action.
The founder of El Ilocano acting alone in 1889.
An unnamed ship carrying sugar in 1859.
hard: How should the exhibit connect the women's request with Rizal's later supportive letter?
Present their initiative first and identify the later letter as support.
Give the initiative entirely to the later letter writer.
Treat the letter as proof that every requested school condition was fulfilled.
Place both events in 1882 with the Diariong Tagalog translation.

label: Different Forms of Participation
quiz: Which pair correctly connects an action with its contribution?
Translation - making a text available in another language.
Founding a newspaper - opening a new canal.
Requesting a school - exporting sugar from Iloilo.
Writing a letter - proving all readers agree.
retry: What do the three exhibit cases show together?
Different people and groups used distinct actions for public concerns.
One famous person performed every action.
All participants had the same income and opportunities.
Public work could only happen outside the Philippines.
hard: Which exhibit explanation is strongest?
Name the translator, publisher and petitioning group, then connect each action with its concern.
List only the richest participant without explaining an action.
Replace the three cases with one claim that everyone agreed.
Treat the date order alone as proof of every action's result.
